title: PM-MCP public source manifest
description: One manifest per public dataset source: its repository, the pinned commit, every file used with its SHA-256 (LFS files by pointer object id and size), its licence SPDX id with text URL, its holders, and third-party content it carries. Fetched datasets are never stored; the manifest is what the loader fetches and checks.

repository.description: dataset repository URL: github.com owner/repo or huggingface.co/datasets owner/dataset

commit.description: pinned commit the loader fetches; a source is updated only by a reviewed change of this pin

files.description: every file of the source the corpus uses

path.description: repository-relative file path (for example HumanEvalComm_v2.csv, input-bouncer/test.csv, tasks.jsonl)

repository.description: override when the file lives in a different repository than the manifest top-level repository (for example bouncerbench-lite inside the bouncerbench manifest); absent inherits the top-level repository

commit.description: override when the file is pinned at a different commit than the manifest top-level commit; absent inherits the top-level commit

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the file; for a Git LFS file the pointer object id

size.description: file size in bytes; for a Git LFS file the pointer size

lfs.description: true when the file is a Git LFS object fetched from the repository LFS endpoint

spdx.description: SPDX license id of the dataset (for example Apache-2.0, MIT, CC-BY-4.0)

url.description: URL of the license text (for example https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0)

holders.description: copyright or dataset holders (for example the HumanEvalComm authors)

third_party.description: content the source itself took from elsewhere, which keeps its own terms

name.description: what the third-party content is (for example HumanEval problems inside HumanEvalComm)

spdx.description: SPDX license id of the third-party content

url.description: URL of the third-party source or its license text
